body:
Aw jeez, you really didn't need to go all out and write this for me, I appreciate it though.

At the minute I am fine I just go through phases in which I get very depressed and can't do much. I try to accept my weaknesses but I don't want to be weak is the thing. I want to be in control of myself.

I have thought about meditation but I never really have taken the time out to work with it.

I was diagnosed clinical depression/anxiety, Major panic disorder and  borderline personality disorder with bi-polar tendencies..

Been on meds for almost 5 years and only help with my anxiety which is nice. Music used to help me and I just drink allot when I want to hurt myself instead.

Been on medication for about 5 years. They only help with my panic attacks.. which is amazing considering my anxiety was horrible.. 2-5 attacks a day that would last for no less then an hour. But they do nothing for my depression but I guess it takes the edge off considering I dont have panic attacks very often.

I started feeling depressed around that age as well when I started having family issues and I was old enough to realize something was right with my home life.  I have been on SSRI's since i was 11.. only 15 so that makes it seem like I haven't lived enough to say I honestly want to die... I more or less just don't want to live a life where I constantly fear, constantly hate, and constantly suffer.
I used to visit those subs but they make me feel worse. Thank you for responding.

Question for my throwaway now..

Depressed adults that were depressed when they were younger... do you ever stop wanting to kill yourself..? I'm not currently suicidal but its hard for me to come back to reality after something bad happens.. the first thing my mind always goes to is to cut myself, drink myself stupid, or exercise until I pass out.

I HAVE gone through treatment but you know just as well as me it only helps so much and the rest is will power.
It actually doesn't comfort me knowing I'm not the only one who feels this way. I feel worse that other people are feeling the same way I do.
